data.narrative:
Aepnus Technology is a seed-stage climate and energy company founded by Lukas Hackl and Bilen Akuzum. The valuation analysis draws from a comparable universe of nine private peers in the Climate & Energy sector, alongside one public comparable (LNZA). Notable private peers include Helion, Redwood Materials, QuantumScape, KoBold Metals, and Electric Hydrogen.

The stage-progression method was the applicable triangulation approach. Using Aepnus's $10.6M in total raised as a proxy for current valuation, a typical seed-to-next-stage step-up multiplier of 2.5x yields an implied valuation of $26.5M. The peer-median method could not be reliably applied due to insufficient datapoints: while nine same-sector peers exist, none of the narrow filters—same-stage, adjacent-stage, or similar-valuation-tier comparables—yielded three or more usable observations. A broad sector median would introduce unacceptable bias given the heterogeneity in the Climate & Energy space.

The triangulated valuation range is $23M (low) to $30M (high), with a median of $26M. This analysis is constrained by reliance on a single method and the absence of tightly matched peer comparables at seed stage. Key uncertainties include the appropriate multiple for seed-to-next-stage progression in the energy technology subsector and the degree to which later-stage, better-capitalized peers inform early-stage valuation dynamics. Further fundraising and milestone achievement will narrow this range materially.
